newsitem.title: CANADA: Hudson's Bay names new president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Hudson's Bay names new president, CEO.

text.p: Hudson's Bay Co said on Monday it appointed William Fields as president and chief executive, replacing George Kosich, effective June 1.
Hudson's Bay said Fields will act in an advisory capacity to the board of directors from April 28 until June 1 and Kosich will remain on the board until his retirement later this year.

Fields was previously president and chief executive at the stores division at Wal-Mart Stores Inc and most recently chairman and chief executive of Blockbuster Entertainment Group, a division of Viacom Inc.
"I am delighted to be returning to the department store industry and am extremely proud to lead such a distinguished company as Hudson's Bay," Fields said.
Hudson's Bay was established in 1670. Through its operating divisions, the Bay and Zellers, is Canada's largest department store retailer.
